Dialogs.Dialog: What kind of TV do you usually watch, ▲小早川＊▲？
So you want to know for no reason？
For no reason, I'm not telling.
Yeah, I'm contrary. Got a problem？
What foods do you like？ Any likes or dislikes？
Normal stuff？ Sorry if you were hoping for a weird answer.
No, a normal answer's fine. Sweets, I guess？
Hmm, I don't hate them, but... potato chips. I could eat chips for all three meals. Oh, but only Kalbee.
Why？ Koumiya's good too. Kind of a connoisseur's pick.
Until a while ago. They went downhill when they upped the seaweed in their seaweed salt. Classic Kalbee is the best.
It is. Ah... now I want Uzushio... I'll buy some on the way home▼
(She must really love them. Not "normal" at all, though...)
Just checking, but do you play any sports, ▲小早川＊▲？
Figured. You give off that vibe.
Well, your arms and legs are so skinny, and you seem like you'd say "Sports？ Huh？"
I would, but not with a weird face like that. ...And there IS something I'm good at.
Ow！ That's from a fighting game！
What music do you like？ You're always listening to something.
Yeah. Music's a big clue to understanding the complex phenomenon that is me.
I see. So what genre do you listen to？
It's less about genre or artist. I listen to songs from the Second British Invasion.
The sound's cheaper than today's, and most of it was made to sell, but then there'll be surreal lyrics, or experimental sounds and videos...
No！ It's easy to get. Geez, were you even listening？ Like, today's visual kei is...
(Did I... just step on a land mine？)
Do you have any hobbies？ ...Oh, besides music.
I can't really picture ▲小早川＊▲'s hobbies. Besides music, I mean.
Why not？ I've got tons of hobbies.
It's true. Lately, anyway. Teasing them is fun.
W-Wait a sec. That's dangerous for a girl to do...
Why？ I mean, at your age... You're not a kid. You get it, right？
Rinko's just a kid, so she doesn't get it！ Hey, hey, why？
Do you have a favorite animal, ▲小早川＊▲？
Animals？ Hmm... Iffy. They smell all beasty.
Well, they're animals... I'd have figured, like, cats...
Huh？ No, I was going to say you seem like you'd like cats...
Oh... Of course I like cats！
Of course, huh... But cats are animals too, right？
No！ Cats are, like, how do I put it... They're not like THAT！ Aaah, I want a cat▼
Kittens go "mew" in this tiny voice, right？ And it just, it just makes me go all weak in the knees...
I might've asked before, but do you have a dream for the future, ▲小早川＊▲？
A dream... Rinko's isn't anything as big as a dream.
I see... So what's this not-so-big thing？
Then if Rinko tells you, will you tell her yours？
Rinko wants to try writing a book.
Huh, I see. You do love books, ▲小早川＊▲.
Not anything hard. Something little kids read. Like the ones on the children's shelf at the library...
Yeah！ And every summer, tons of kids read Rinko's book. Then they groan their way through book reports on it.
Ahaha！ I love it. That's so ▲小早川＊▲.
Hey, what about you？ Your dream.
Huh？ Me, well... I'll make ▲小早川＊▲ happy. ...Or something.
(Yeah, I bet ▲小早川＊▲ could write a good book.)
What's your dream for the future, ▲小早川＊▲？
Who brings that up at our age？
Ugh... But you've at least thought about it, right？
Nope. No future. These days, the planet might be done for anyway.
Global warming, food shortages？ But if we act now, I'm sure...
Then what about aliens？ Aliens might invade, you know？
Well, I guess that one's still fine for now...
Hmm, aliens, huh. Uh-oh, what do we do？
Is there a woman even ▲小早川＊▲ looks up to？
That "even" bugs me. But... I can't think of anyone.
Girls grow up faster than guys. Girls get the short end.
You think？ Guys have it pretty tough too, you know？
You just keep becoming more of a woman. Sometimes I think the old me might just disappear...
Um, so, like... health class stuff...
Is there a woman even ▲小早川＊▲ looks up to？
Once women grow up, they get treated like supporting characters.
Rinko hates that. She wants something else.
Something else... You mean, like a man？
No！ What Rinko wants to be is... something else... um, something you wouldn't get！
(She doesn't get it herself, does she？)
Is there a woman even ▲小早川＊▲ looks up to？
Maybe it's not quite "look up to," but moms with little kids.
They shop while holding a kid who weighs like ten kilos, and deal with them all day. Rinko could never.
That really is amazing... But when ▲小早川＊▲ is a mom, I bet she'll be like that too.
Yeah. I guess someday I'll be a dad too...
What kind of movies do you like, ▲小早川＊▲？
Oh, you're looking down on them.
Not really？ Just... terminal illness？ Humanity on the brink？ You can see the ending from the poster.
From the poster, ▲小早川＊▲... Then what about comedy or horror？
"We'll make you laugh," "We'll scare you." Good for them, I guess.
Well, the people making them are trying hard...
Isn't there one where nobody dies, no weird gags, no ghosts, just a peaceful world？
There probably is if you look... You want to watch that？
You really do like books, ▲小早川＊▲？
What kind do you like most？
American stuff from the '50s and '60s. You wouldn't know them if I told you.
That's not it. Nobody my age reads the books I read...
And besides, I think real books only make sense to people who need what's written in them.
You think I wouldn't get them？
Part of me wants you to get them, and part of me doesn't. ...I don't know.
